text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Needle Series—the grand stage
where
humans augmented by
acupuncture race each
other for ultimate
supremacy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today will be our first step towards
conquering
that series—the day of the
Bamboo Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Mysterious Beauty
text_block_list.text:
Oh! <username>,
please help
meee!
choice_data_list: 待ち合わせ場所はここかな
choice_data_list_en: I guess this is the meetup spot.

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Yes, of course! I knew it, I'm just not me without my charismatic Miracle Shining Sunglasses!
choice_data_list: ……もしかしなくても安心沢さんですか？
choice_data_list_en: ...Wait, could you be—no, you're definitely Anshinzawa-san, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Oh, absolutely! Without them, I have nothing but worries! For a genius acupuncturist-slash-trainer like me, they're almost as important as life itself!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
But alas! They got blown by the wind
into the
back of a truck, then the truck
carried them far,
far away, then they
were picked up by a stray
dog—

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Sadly, yes... Sniffle... Please, you must help me...
choice_data_list: 見失ったって感じですかね？
choice_data_list_en: Does it feel like we lost track of it?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fortunately, there's still time until I have
to run in
the Bamboo Stakes, so Sasami
Anshinzawa and I
decide to look for her
sunglasses together.

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: They're not here...

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Nor here...

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Or even here...

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Hey, look! The dog underneath the
overpass!
That's the one!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
I've finally caught up to you now! Return
my
sunglasses at once!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
They're a family heirloom, and um... also

represent the wearer's determination to
be a
beacon of reassurance to
Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
In the Legend of the Anshinzawas... It
was, uh...
Yasuzaemon Anshinzawa? Who
said something
along those lines!
Probably! ♪
choice_data_list: あのサングラスにそんな逸話が……！
choice_data_list_en: There was a story like that behind those sunglasses...?!

text_block_list.name: Stray Dog
text_block_list.text: Grrrrrowl!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Eeeeek!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Right as the stray dog poises to strike, I
seize the
opportunity and snatch the
sunglasses away!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even stray dogs are no match for me
now... I bask
in my feeling of
accomplishment as I hand the
sunglasses
back to Sasami Anshinzawa.

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Swoon... ☆

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Phew, looks like we somehow made it on
time. ♪
Feeling ready?

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Of course you would be! This is where
my needles
come in handy! Let me give
your Courageous
Challenger chakra a
little poke! ☆
choice_data_list: 実はちょっと緊張していて……

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Don't be shy! It's my way of saying
thanks for
recovering my family
heirloom! ♪

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Here I go! Annnd poke!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Puncture Perfect!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Strangely enough, as soon as she pokes
me, all
feelings of doubt disappear from
my mind, and an
abundance of power
wells up in me!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Wow! I really did it! I knew it was worth
a shot! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I start towards the race track in high
spirits, but...
choice_data_list: ありがとうございます！

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Hold on! I have something for you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As soon as she pokes me, my anxiety
begins to
grow in intensity. At this rate, I
feel like my
nervousness will completely
overwhelm me!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: W-wait... Did that not work? It didn't?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I quickly start towards the race track in
an
attempt to shake off the heavy
feeling, but...
choice_data_list: き、気合いで勝ってきますよ！
choice_data_list_en: I-I'll win this with pure fighting spirit!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Hold on! I have something for you!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Here! Take my Miracle Shining
Sunglasses! ♪

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, you look great in them! ♪ With
those on,
you'll have nothing to worry
about!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
No need to hold back! We've been
through thick
and thin together! ♪
choice_data_list: これ、大事なものなんじゃ
choice_data_list_en: Isn't this something important to you?

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
That's exactly why I feel confident
entrusting
them to you! ☆ Get out there
and break a leg!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The sunglasses bestowed upon me
imbue my body
with great strength!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I've heard stories of signature racewear
bringing
out the wearer's inner strength,
which means...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Knowing that Sasami Anshinzawa is
cheering me
on from the stands, I run
with all my might in
hopes of winning the
trophy for her!
choice_data_list: （それなら……これが俺の勝負服だ……！）
（それなら……これが私の勝負服だ……！）
choice_data_list_en: (In that case... this is my Racewear...!)
(In that case... this is my Racewear...!)

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
In a magnificent performance,

<chrname>'s trainer has
crossed the
finish line in first place!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Like a shooting star, he's appeared out
of
nowhere and taken the Bamboo
Stakes by storm!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Like a shooting star, she's appeared out
of
nowhere and taken the Bamboo
Stakes by storm!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Yesss! You did it,

<username>!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
I knew you'd be able to do it, partner! ♪
Time to
keep winning all the way to the
top!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
I'll have to get another pair of those
sunglasses
from the dollar store too! ☆
